blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) and the Department of Education (DepEd) Iloilo City Division are exploring having students use transparent school bags to prevent prohibited items from entering campus. During a coordination meeting on Monday, ICPO City Director Col. Wilbert Parilla presented the transparent-bag proposal to DepEd officials for initial assessment of its feasibility, acceptability, and potential implementation challenges. If adopted, the measure would deter students from bringing bladed weapons, firearms, and other prohibited items into school premises.
